name: Quest log: each quest's level, reward XP and scaled mark reach the client
contract: Requires DestinyWeaver.Enable=1, CoA.QuestLevelScaling=1 and CoA.QuestLevelScaling.ClientFlag=0 (the default). The Ascension client's Extensions.dll answers GetQuestLogTitle's level and the quest log's reward XP for a quest in the log from the player's SMSG_UPDATE_OBJECT_ADDON (0x0578) table, field 61 + quest log slot for the level and field 36 + slot for the XP, instead of the quest cache. Without them the log shows every quest as level 0 in grey. Its GetQuestScaling reads quest flag 0x01000000 from the quest query response and then computes the level from its own copy of the curve; with ClientFlag off the server never sets it and the slot level is what the log shows. Quest 7 (Kobold Camp Cleanup) is authored at level 2 and its QuestTemplateScaling.dbc row is min 2, max 20, offset -4 from player level 6. With open-world scaling on, a level 20 character plays it at 16 and the slot must carry 16 and a positive XP reward; with scaling off it carries the authored level 2; a level up to 21 re-sends 17. Client rendering is not tested.

steps.label: The server plays the quest on its curve
Accepting the quest sends its scaled level to its slot
Accepting the quest sends a positive reward XP to its slot
Without ClientFlag the quest is not marked as scaled
Without scaling the server uses the authored level
Turning scaling off sends the authored level
Turning scaling on sends the scaled level again
A level up sends the new scaled level
